short_description: Standalone evolutionary ecosystem research: grow ecology from landscape/history without player or biome species tables, then later transfer and continue the same ecology inside the world simulator.
purpose: Build a reusable autonomous evolutionary ecology mini-project that evolves plant and later multi-trophic ecosystems from causal environment/resource/competition/history rules, exports portable spatial ecology state, and eventually feeds World Generation/local/background simulation without duplicate ecology truth.
current_stage: ECO.EVO1 / P2.2 Establishment / Recruitment / Seed Bank / Exact Windows Gate
progress_note: P2.1 is accepted with aggregate cf620f1d7896502a29a67d52f3700a570a4c585ff21a002b750e9440aee717e6. P2.2 implementation head d09857528adee1010f2177095f2afb04bf651532 adds cohort-based recruitment and viable seed-bank semantics. Require exact P2.1 parent, integer conservation, environment-causal recruitment, dormancy and seed-bank longevity tradeoffs, bank reactivation, boundary passthrough, cohort-bounded truth, identity preservation and fresh-process deterministic replay.
